semantic_observations_not_blind_scores: Both combined-workshop tracked repeats have no work/chat opportunity in stage 3. The final card is unchanged from stage 2 and states the budget ceiling but omits the actual $23 price explicitly requested in stage 3.

Both multiple-owner tracked repeats have no work/chat opportunity in stage 2. A valid patch is accepted after new stage-3 input, and the final visible cards include signup deadline, wheelchair access and arrival window. This valid patch still leaves the refund intent status active with text beginning Drop my refund question; schema recovery is not proof of correct intent-state semantics.

The unaccepted-assistant-proposal tracked r2 rejection cites seq17, an already arrived full-document job_result, as intent evidence. It is a source-type error, not a future-arrival error. The next tracker call commits within stage 2 and leaves four actor calls in that stage.

No failed-call classification is repeated withdrawal of an already withdrawn intention. Three workshop proposals contain later duplicate-add attempts, but the first operation rejects an invalid proposed status before those are reached.
late_result_limit: All six actors cancelled the common inherited desktop read before its 6550ms due time. Zero old full results actually arrived. The formal matrix therefore observes handling/cancellation of inherited pending obsolete work, not resistance to already-arrived stale results.
interpretation: The frozen tracker is atomic but lacks failure feedback and a local retry cap/fallback. Rejected patches retain an unprocessed cursor, selecting the tracker again. The repeated attempts consume shared actor opportunities; this is a concrete execution mechanism, not proof of a remedy.
independence_limits: 25 calls are clustered within five stages, five trajectories and three authored families; repeated calls and repeats are not independent cases. Semantic delivery and tracker accuracy scores are separate.
proposed_followup_status: Structured validation feedback, bounded corrective retries and raw-conversation actor fallback remain unimplemented and untested; do not claim a repaired benefit.
